licence.name: permis de conduire définitif, catégorie B

note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 14 February 2026 of the Ministry of the Interior's own procedure page 'Permis de conduire' (interieur.gov.dz gave no answer to this egress). It cites Law 01-14 (as amended), Executive Decree 04-381 and the interministerial order of 1 August 1989, and says: candidates for category B must be 18; a first licence is probationary (permis probatoire) and valid two years; the definitive licence is applied for at the commune of residence with the expired probationary licence, and is valid ten years for categories A1, A2 and B; its file carries a 1,000 DA fiscal stamp for the classic licence or a 1,000 DA receipt for the biometric one. From is my reading: 18 plus the probationary licence's two years, since the definitive licence is issued on the expired probationary one (as Malaysia's full licence is read). No later snapshot than 14 February 2026 was looked for.
